translations.web: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.
translations.bsb: They will bring you down to the Pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
translations.kjv: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
translations.asv: They shall bring thee down to the pit; and thou shalt die the death of them that are slain, in the heart of the seas.
